comparison.objective: Clip an IV tube while preserving a measured slack loop; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Compliant tube insertion and slack shaping versus rigid tool use, collar tuning, locking, and dynamic observation.
comparison.success_condition: Tube clipped with 5–15 cm excess and hub undisturbed versus safe repeatable stops. Clip seating threshold is unspecified.
comparison.reason: Deformable slack management and rigid-body commissioning are meaningfully different.
